lead: Lata Mangeshkar was an Indian singer, born on 28 September 1929 in Indore.
She died on 6 February 2022 in Mumbai at the age of 92.
She has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
This profile collects the Lata facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Lata Mangeshkar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Lata Mangeshkar was born on 28 September 1929 in Indore, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Deenanath Mangeshkar. She is a sibling of Hridaynath Mangeshkar, Usha Mangeshkar, Meena Khadikar and Asha Bhosle.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Lata Mangeshkar — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists film actor, film score composer, film producer, playback singer and musician as her occupations.
She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (1999–2005).
